summary: FD_TC_225_3rd Party � Individual with POA � No Document Provided � Claim Denied
title: 3rd Party � Individual with POA � No Document Provided � Claim Denied
description:
Validates that when an individual claims to have authority but cannot or refuses to upload proof of authorization, the system denies the claim.

Prerequisites:
Third-party caller type: Legal/Guardian/Tutor/Insurer/FI. User cannot provide documentation.
